Title: Code layer pass
Description: As a desktop user, I want to extract architectural layer knowledge from multi-folder code repositories so that patent candidates understand the system architecture. The app groups file-level knowledge by top folder/project (3+ files only), sends items (no code) with layer-prompt.v1.json, and produces layer items. The Review screen shows them.
AcceptanceCriteria: File-level knowledge items are grouped by top folder/project
Only repos with 3+ files in a folder are processed for layers
Layer prompt (layer-prompt.v1.json) is loaded from embedded resources
Prompt builder includes file paths and knowledge summaries (no full code)
Layer items are produced with kind=layer and folder file_path
Review screen filters and displays layer items separately
Layer items are included in upload batch
End-to-end check: multi-folder code repo produces layer items and uploads
All code for this story lives inside Cortexa-dev/desktop/collector; nothing in services/, contracts/, frontend/ or deploy/ is edited or referenced (outside logic is re-implemented inside)
TalkingPoints: Implementing a second-pass code layer extraction that groups file-level knowledge by folder and generates architectural layer knowledge. Loading layer-prompt.v1.json and producing layer items without exposing full code.

Tasks.Title: Implement folder grouping logic
Tasks.Description: Group file-level knowledge items by top folder; filter for 3+ files per folder.

Tasks.Title: Build layer prompt builder
Tasks.Description: Load layer-prompt.v1.json; build prompt with file paths and knowledge summaries (no code).

Tasks.Title: Extract layer items via Claude
Tasks.Description: Call Claude provider with layer prompt; parse response; produce layer items with kind=layer.

Tasks.Title: Display layer items in Review screen
Tasks.Description: Filter Review screen to show layer items; include folder path and description.

Tasks.Title: Include layer items in batch upload
Tasks.Description: Add layer items to batch payload with unit_kind=module, kind=layer, and folder file_path.

Tasks.Title: Test layer extraction and upload
Tasks.Description: Verify layer items are correctly extracted, displayed, and uploaded.
